controversial.en: The new law is highly [controversial;empirical;thorough;legislative] and divides public opinion.

to justify.uk: Як ти можеш [обґрунтувати] такі великі витрати?

consequently.en: He missed the deadline and, [consequently;fortunately;rarely;conversely], lost the contract.

competitive advantage.en: Low prices give the firm a strong [competitive advantage;legislative power;random sample;false assumption].

profitable.en: After years of losses, the shop is finally [profitable;legislative;empirical;thorough].

to beat around the bush.en: — Stop [beating around the bush;turning a blind eye;playing with fire;racking your brains] and tell me what happened!
to beat around the bush.da: — Hold op med at [gå som katten om den varme grød;lege med ilden;bryde dit hoved;tage tyren ved hornene], og fortæl mig, hvad der skete!

the last straw.en: He was often late, but missing the wedding was [the last straw;a piece of cake;a blessing in disguise;the icing on the cake]: she left him.

the last straw.it: Arrivava spesso in ritardo, ma saltare il matrimonio è stata [la goccia che ha fatto traboccare il vaso;una passeggiata;una benedizione;la ciliegina sulla torta]: lei lo ha lasciato.

to learn the hard way.en: I [learned the hard way;turned a blind eye;made ends meet;played with fire] that you should always back up your files.

to take the bull by the horns.en: Instead of avoiding the problem, she decided to [take the bull by the horns;play with fire;cry over spilt milk;bury her head in the sand].

to take the bull by the horns.uk: Замість того щоб уникати проблеми, вона вирішила [взяти бика за роги].

to play with fire.en: Investing all your savings in crypto is [playing with fire;taking the bull by the horns;throwing down the gauntlet;crying over spilt milk].

to play with fire.uk: Вкладати всі заощадження в криптовалюту — це [гратися з вогнем].

to be in the same boat.en: — I might lose my job. — Don't worry, we're all [in the same boat;on cloud nine;worth our weight in gold;playing with fire].

to be in the same boat.it: — Forse perderò il lavoro. — Tranquillo, siamo tutti [sulla stessa barca;al settimo cielo;in alto mare;di buon umore].
to be in the same boat.uk: — Я можу втратити роботу. — Не хвилюйся, ми всі [в одному човні].

to be worth its weight in gold.en: These days a good plumber [is worth his weight in gold;is on cloud nine;is in the same boat;is playing with fire].
to be worth its weight in gold.da: En god VVS'er [er guld værd;er i den syvende himmel;sidder i samme båd;leger med ilden] nu om dage.
to be worth its weight in gold.it: Oggigiorno un buon idraulico [vale tanto oro quanto pesa;è al settimo cielo;è sulla stessa barca;scherza col fuoco].

to keep one's mouth shut.en: If anyone asks about the surprise party, [keep your mouth shut;take the bull by the horns;play with fire;make ends meet]!

to keep one's mouth shut.uk: Якщо хтось питатиме про вечірку-сюрприз, [тримай язик за зубами]!

like a bolt from the blue.en: The news of his resignation came [like a bolt from the blue;at the end of the day;on cloud nine;in the same boat].

like a bolt from the blue.uk: Новина про його відставку прозвучала [як грім серед ясного неба].

to make ends meet.en: With two kids and one salary, they struggle to [make ends meet;turn a blind eye;play with fire;beat around the bush].

to make ends meet.uk: З двома дітьми й однією зарплатою їм важко [зводити кінці з кінцями].

straight from the horse's mouth.en: — Are you sure he's leaving? — Yes, I heard it [straight from the horse's mouth;like a bolt from the blue;at the end of the day;on cloud nine].
straight from the horse's mouth.da: — Er du sikker på, at han stopper? — Ja, jeg har det [fra første hånd;i den syvende himmel;med nød og næppe;når alt kommer til alt].
straight from the horse's mouth.it: — Sei sicuro che se ne va? — Sì, l'ho saputo [di prima mano;al settimo cielo;in fin dei conti;per niente al mondo].

once in a blue moon.en: We only see each other [once in a blue moon;in the nick of time;by the skin of our teeth;on the spur of the moment].
once in a blue moon.da: Vi ses kun [en gang hvert jubelår;i sidste øjeblik;med nød og næppe;på stående fod].
once in a blue moon.it: Ci vediamo solo [a ogni morte di papa;per un pelo;all'ultimo momento;su due piedi].
once in a blue moon.uk: Ми бачимося лише [раз на сто років].

to pull someone's leg.en: Don't worry, I'm just [pulling your leg;breaking the ice;hitting the sack;spilling the beans]!
to pull someone's leg.da: Bare rolig, jeg [tager bare gas på dig;bryder bare isen;går bare i seng;sladrer bare].
to pull someone's leg.it: Tranquillo, ti sto solo [prendendo in giro;rompendo il ghiaccio;vuotando il sacco;dando buca]!

to poke one's nose into.en: Stop [poking your nose into;turning a blind eye to;keeping an eye on;taking a shine to] my private life!
to poke one's nose into.da: Hold op med at [stikke næsen i;se gennem fingre med;holde øje med;falde for] mit privatliv!
to poke one's nose into.it: Smettila di [ficcare il naso;chiudere un occhio;dare un'occhiata;fare il tifo] nella mia vita privata!
to poke one's nose into.uk: Перестань [пхати носа в] моє особисте життя!

the tip of the iceberg.en: These complaints are only [the tip of the iceberg;the last straw;the icing on the cake;the elephant in the room].
the tip of the iceberg.da: Disse klager er kun [toppen af isbjerget;dråben der flød over;prikken over i'et;elefanten i rummet].
the tip of the iceberg.it: Questi reclami sono solo [la punta dell'iceberg;la ciliegina sulla torta;la pecora nera;l'ultima spiaggia].

to be up to one's ears in work.en: Sorry, I can't come, I'm [up to my ears in work;over the moon;on cloud nine;down in the dumps].
to be up to one's ears in work.da: Undskyld, jeg kan ikke komme, jeg [har arbejde til op over begge ører;er i den syvende himmel;er helt oppe at køre;er langt nede].

to be up to one's ears in work.uk: Вибач, не можу прийти, я [по вуха в роботі].

to make a mountain out of a molehill.en: It's a small mistake, don't [make a mountain out of a molehill;burn the midnight oil;bite the bullet;hit the road].
to make a mountain out of a molehill.da: En lille fejl – du skal ikke [gøre en myg til en elefant;slå to fluer med ét smæk;tage tyren ved hornene;brænde dine broer].

to make a mountain out of a molehill.uk: Це дрібна помилка, не [роби з мухи слона].

to add fuel to the fire.en: His angry tweet only [added fuel to the fire;broke the ice;saved the day;cleared the air].
to add fuel to the fire.da: Hans vrede opslag [hældte kun benzin på bålet;brød kun isen;reddede kun dagen;rensede kun luften].

to add fuel to the fire.uk: Його злий допис лише [підлив масла у вогонь].

to be on the same wavelength.en: My new colleague and I are [on the same wavelength;in hot water;under the weather;out of the blue].
to be on the same wavelength.da: Min nye kollega og jeg er [på bølgelængde;på glatis;på herrens mark;i den syvende himmel].
to be on the same wavelength.it: Io e il mio nuovo collega siamo [sulla stessa lunghezza d'onda;al verde;in alto mare;con l'acqua alla gola].
to be on the same wavelength.uk: Ми з моїм новим колегою [на одній хвилі].

to have one's head in the clouds.en: He never listens in class, he [has his head in the clouds;has his feet on the ground;has a heart of gold;has a sweet tooth].
to have one's head in the clouds.da: Han hører aldrig efter i timen, han [går med hovedet i skyerne;har begge ben på jorden;har et hjerte af guld;har en sød tand].

to have one's head in the clouds.uk: Він ніколи не слухає на уроках, він [витає в хмарах].

a piece of cake.en: — Was the exam difficult? — No, it was [a piece of cake;a slap in the face;a pain in the neck;a shot in the dark].
a piece of cake.da: — Var eksamen svær? — Nej, det var [en smal sag;et slag i ansigtet;en pine;et skud i tågen].
a piece of cake.it: — L'esame era difficile? — No, era [un gioco da ragazzi;uno schiaffo in faccia;una spina nel fianco;un buco nell'acqua].

to put all one's eggs in one basket.en: Diversify your investments, don't [put all your eggs in one basket;let the cat out of the bag;beat around the bush;bury the hatchet].

to put all one's eggs in one basket.uk: Диверсифікуй інвестиції, не [став усе на одну карту].

to know like the back of one's hand.en: Born here, I [know Kyiv like the back of my hand;know Kyiv by hearsay;know Kyiv from postcards;know Kyiv from the air].

to take for granted.en: We often [take for granted;take to heart;take by storm;take into custody] the people who love us.

peer review.en: The article was accepted after a careful peer [review;picnic;haircut;sandwich].

correlation.en: There is a strong [correlation;cupcake;umbrella;bathroom] between education and income.

to paraphrase.en: You should [paraphrase;sneeze;whistle;knit] the quotation instead of copying it.

to outline.en: In the introduction, I will briefly [outline;sneeze;fry;iron] the main arguments.

to elaborate.en: Could you [elaborate;sunbathe;yawn;skate] on your last point, please?

to elaborate.uk: Чи не могли б ви [детальніше пояснити] свою останню думку?

coherent.en: A good essay presents a [coherent;sleepy;hungry;salty] line of argument.

in conclusion.uk: [На завершення], результати підтверджують нашу початкову гіпотезу.

social benefit.en: He receives a [social benefit;birthday cake;fishing rod;sunflower] while he is looking for work.

parental leave.en: She is on parental [leave;soup;paint;cheese] until the baby is one year old.

nursery.en: Our daughter started at the [nursery;volcano;airport;prison] when she was ten months old.

nursery.uk: Наша донька пішла в [ясла], коли їй було десять місяців.

social safety net.en: The social safety [net;cake;shoe;kettle] protects people who lose their jobs.
